approval_rule: 2026-11-19, repository owner: no separate executor and approver, no named approval or formal sign-off. The repository owner decides; a status changes when evidence that can be checked is in the repository (what was run, on which commits and images, what was seen), not when someone signs.

runtime_verification_notes.rule: RUN means it was run and the evidence is in the repository; it is not a statement that everything passed. What was seen, and what was not shown, is listed per item. Changed from NOT_RUN on 2026-11-19 by decision of the repository owner (see approval_rule).

agentgateway.seen: The pinned agentgateway 1.7.0, real binary and real image. Black-box suite on the evidence file above: 97 cases, 96 pass. Single-host pool suite recorded earlier: 30 cases, three rounds. Both WanbExpress and SF International have been run on the single-host pool. On 2026-11-20 the same binary was probed on loopback for gateway-control sync-jwks (jwks.file reload without a gateway restart), per-account HTTP 429 rate limits, frontendPolicies.http.maxConcurrentRequests, frontendPolicies.tcp.maxConnections, and route localRateLimit. Compose three rounds were not rerun for these commits. tests/integration/compose/run.py builds gateway-control and runs only publish, restart, reconcile, place, and keep. Since 78aee90, cmd/gateway-control/main.go returns early for sync-jwks and compile before the existing switch; the publish and keep implementations were not changed. gateway-authz rate limits and the provider-signer circuit breaker are not on this suite's path. The earlier record (30 cases, about 750 seconds a round, three rounds; dates in tests/integration/compose/README.md) still stands and is not replaced. The black-box suite was rerun from the clean tree at 6c5659d; evidence commit 4416f89; the file records repository_commit 6c5659d and 0 uncommitted files; 97 cases, 96 passed, 751 checks. The only failure is the known P1-SS-04 (two Host headers). --check-evidence prints OK p1-run-agentgateway-1.7.0.json (96/97 passed, commit 6c5659d). Compared with the evidence on 149aa0e, no case and no check differs in text or result. The file spans 2026-11-20T13:54:53Z to 13:56:06Z (72.5s); commit 4416f89 records wall-clock 74.825s.
reservations: In the black-box suite Gatekeeper and the provider are stand-ins.
The image signature was not verified.

gatekeeper_extauthz.seen: A real Gatekeeper at commit f36dc06 run on the development machine: tokens it signs are verified by the gateway, gateway-authz asks its PDP with a client certificate. 12 of the 12 default cases pass. On 2026-11-20, with --key-rotation, 13 of 13 cases passed twice in a row. GK-12 passed both times: gateway-control sync-jwks wrote .run/jwks.json; the new Hydra key was accepted in 2.015s and then in 1.012s, without restarting the gateway.
reservations: It is a local instance with local changes (provider_account type, the dedicated audience by a global switch, a TLS terminator in front of the PDP), not an environment run by the Gatekeeper team.
No environment claim in the token.
The provider in that suite is a stand-in.
